lines: - Brimon: "My best course yet, my best time yet. Neither Dax nor Demon can beat me."
- Brimon: "Mathila says I'm both handsome and swift. Is it true? It's not for me to say."
- Brimon: "I'm pretty handy with a blade myself. Makes the Dax jealous."
- Brimon: "You handle a Kaithe like you've done it countless times before. Reminds me of myself."
- Brimon: "Bombastine tried racing me once. He didn't try again."
- Brimon: "You umm... ever wonder why Mathila's so... happy?"
- Brimon: "This is my favorite course. But there's no shame in you finding it too challenging."
- Brimon: "I say you fancy yourself a rider? Haha, a wager, then! You impress me, and I'll help you out. What do you say?"
- Brimon: "Beat the best, or wallow with the rest. Care for a race, Drifter?"
- Brimon: "Name's Brimon, fastest Kaithe rider in the kingdom. If you think you're faster... prove it."
- Brimon: "Beat my time? That's rich! Love it."
- Brimon: "I get it. Why race when you know you can't win?"
- Brimon: "Best of luck! You'll need it!"
- Brimon: "By the King, you are fast!"
- Brimon: "Not bad. Not bad at all."
- Brimon: "Dear me! Have you been practicing?"
- Brimon: "What? That's impossi... fine. A little something for your trouble."
- Brimon: "How? I've reached that course a million... oh, very well. Take this."
- Brimon: "That was... impressive. Here, this is for you."
- Brimon: "No shame in losing to the best, eh?"
- Brimon: "Is there nobody capable of challenging me? Huh?"
- Brimon: "Chin up! You'll do better next time. Hopefully."
